result.question: What does the prophet say about his burial?

readings.answer: That when he dies, he must be buried in the tomb where the man of God is buried, with his bones laid beside the man of God’s bones.
readings.support: When I die, you must bury me in the tomb where the man of God is buried. Lay my bones beside his bones,

assessments.reason: It states he is to be buried in the same tomb as the man of God with his bones beside his, which matches “Bury me with the man.”

result.reason: The passage explicitly has the prophet ask to be buried in the same tomb as the man of God, i.e., with him.
